name: Theatre Square
simplified:
## Task
Find the minimum number of square tiles of size $a \times a$ needed to cover a rectangle of size $n \times m$.

## Details
- Tiles may not be broken.
- Tile sides must be parallel to the sides of the rectangle.
- The tiles may cover more than the rectangle, but the whole rectangle must be covered.

## Input
- One line with three integers $n$, $m$ and $a$ ($1 \le n, m, a \le 10^9$).

## Output
- Print the minimum number of tiles.
